;International relations
*[[Australia–United Kingdom relations]]
**Several senior [[Australia]]n MPs cancel a planned trip to the [[United Kingdom]] next month due to the latter allowing [[Huawei]] to help build its national [[5G]] network. Australia had banned the Chinese telecom from participating in [[Telecommunications in Australia|their network]] due to [[Criticism of Huawei#Espionage and security concerns|security concerns]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-australia-51513886 (BBC News)]
*[[India–Turkey relations]]
**[[Ministry of External Affairs (India)|Indian Ministry of External Affairs]] spokesman [[Raveesh Kumar]] tells [[President of Turkey|Turkish President]] [[Recep Tayyip Erdoğan]] to "not interfere in [[India]]'s internal affairs" after he and [[Prime Minister of Pakistan|Pakistani Prime Minister]] [[Imran Khan]] issued a joint declaration yesterday condemning the [[2019–20 Jammu and Kashmir lockdown|lockdown]] in [[Jammu and Kashmir (union territory)|Jammu and Kashmir]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/02/kashmir-india-tells-turkey-don-interfere-internal-affairs-200215182136914.html (Al Jazeera)]
